ui.lang.name: English
title.how: Something was left here. No one came for it.
intro.goal: you don't remember who you are. three things are here. start with them.
title.warn: Flashes of light are always soft. Places change suddenly.
session.erased: this place is gone. another one opens.
limbo.wait: rendering the next one from what is left…
limbo.line.0: low detail is not an error. this is how you kept it.
limbo.line.1: people who remembered this also remembered: the smell of the stairwell.
limbo.line.2: your childhood was archived due to inactivity.
limbo.line.3: this memory is not sponsored. yet.
limbo.line.4: nothing here is saved. everything here is kept.
limbo.line.5: skip intro? you can't. you are the intro.
toast.ultra: Ultra can’t keep up here — switched to high.
toast.room.dark: …no light was kept here. only the lines.
toast.room.wire: …the seams are open here. don't stand still.
toast.edge: …it ends here. i don't remember the rest.
teach.dark: Light off: what you are looking for shows through the walls.
teach.thing: Things do not like being stared at.
teach.dark.still: Stand still: the lights go out, and what you are looking for shows through the walls.
teach.dark.first.desktop: Turn the flashlight off (F): in the dark, what you are looking for shows through the walls
teach.dark.first.touch: Tap the flashlight button to turn it off: in the dark, what you are looking for shows through the walls
teach.dark.seen: There it is. Turn the light back on and go to it.
teach.hold: Keep it in your light until you remember it
teach.touch: Nothing here can be touched. Light off, light on — and it is back. Maybe not the same.
teach.touch.still: Nothing here can be touched. Stand still until the lights go out — it comes back with the light. Maybe not the same.
mem.kettle.flash: the kettle. you left it on.
mem.kettle.done: it was cold. it was always cold.
mem.iron.flash: the iron. did you unplug it?
mem.iron.done: unplugged. you checked three times. you will check again.
mem.phone.flash: your phone is ringing somewhere. unknown number.
mem.phone.done: one new memory. tap to dismiss.
mem.keys.flash: the keys. you had them a second ago.
mem.keys.done: they open a door that is not here any more.
mem.teddy.flash: you promised to come back for him.
mem.teddy.done: he waited. he is not angry. that is worse.
mem.slippers.flash: someone's slippers by the door. whose?
mem.alarm.flash: the alarm is set for an hour that does not exist.
mem.alarm.done: it rang yesterday. you slept through the whole year.
mem.mug.flash: the tea you made and forgot.
mem.mug.done: a ring on the table. nothing else is left.
mem.photo.flash: a photo of everyone. the faces did not save.
mem.photo.done: you are in it. third from the left. probably.
mem.call.flash: a phone with a dial. it knows one number by heart.
mem.call.done: you dialled home. home picked up and breathed.
mem.nightlight.flash: the night light. do not turn it off.
mem.nightlight.done: it was never for the dark. it was for you.
mem.bag.flash: the homework is due. it has been due for twenty years.
mem.bag.done: inside: one page. your handwriting. not your words.
mem.cake.done: the candles count something. not years.
mem.ball.flash: the ball went over the fence. go and get it.
mem.ball.done: nobody was waiting for it. you brought it back anyway.
mem.fish.flash: you forgot to feed the fish.
mem.fish.done: it forgot you first. three seconds at a time.
mem.remote.flash: where is the remote? the channel will not change.
pocket.void.enter: this is what you kept. the blank ones are still missing.
pocket.meadow.enter: default background. nothing finds you here. the door leads closer.
pocket.meadow.enter.idle: default background. nothing finds you here. the door leads back.
pocket.dollhouse.enter: a red room. what is forgotten is kept here.
pocket.dollhouse.enter.idle: a red room. nothing of yours is forgotten yet.
pocket.dollhouse.map.idle: nothing of yours is here yet.
pocket.hint.fading: This place is fading. It will let you go
mem.terminal.flash: the terminal. you never logged out.
mem.terminal.done: the session is still open. it has your name on it.
mem.deskphone.flash: the desk phone. line two was for you.
mem.deskphone.done: you picked up. it was you, asking when you would be back.
mem.report.flash: the report. due friday. it does not say which.
mem.report.done: every page is the cover page.
mem.cactus.flash: the cactus on your desk. the one thing you kept alive.
mem.cactus.done: it did not need you. that is why it lived.
mem.wallclock.flash: the clock. ten to six, for nine years.
mem.wallclock.done: it was right twice a day. so were you.
mem.desklamp.flash: the lamp you left on over the weekend.
mem.desklamp.done: nobody turned it off. nobody was there to mind.
mem.chair.flash: your chair. it kept your shape.
mem.chair.done: someone else sits in it now. it fits them better.
mem.cooler.flash: the water cooler. where everything was really decided.
mem.cooler.done: you remember the talk. not one word of it.
mem.sign.flash: the yellow sign. the floor was never wet.
mem.sign.done: it warns about something that already happened.

mem.st_coat.flash: a hat on the platform. yours.
mem.st_coat.done: behind the band: a note. your handwriting.
teach.touch.station: Nothing here can be touched. When a train passes and the hall goes dark, the thing comes back. Maybe as something else.
teach.dark.station: Stop: what you are looking for can only be remembered while you stand still.
mem.sh_alarm.flash: the alarm is set for an hour that does not exist.
mem.sh_alarm.done: it rang. nobody got up. in the kitchen, the kettle was already on.
mem.sh_kettle.flash: the kettle. you left it on.
mem.sh_kettle.done: two cups. the second one is still in the living room.
mem.sh_remote.flash: where is the remote? the channel will not change.
mem.sh_remote.done: every channel shows the hallway. someone is standing by the door.
mem.sh_photo.flash: a photo of everyone. the faces did not save.
mem.sh_photo.done: you are in it. third from the left. still asleep. the alarm is about to ring.
mem.of_terminal.flash: the terminal. you never logged out.
mem.of_terminal.done: one unread message: see me. it came from the manager's office.
mem.of_chair.flash: your chair is in the manager's office now.
mem.of_chair.done: it still turns to the window. behind it, the files.
mem.of_cooler.flash: the water cooler. where everything was really decided.
mem.of_cooler.done: you remember the talk. not one word of it. the phone at reception is ringing.
mem.of_phone.flash: the desk phone. line two was for you.
mem.of_phone.done: you picked up. it was you, at your desk, asking when you would be back.
mem.ye_sign.flash: the yellow sign. the floor was never wet.
mem.ye_sign.done: it points down the hall, to the break room.
mem.ye_kettle.flash: a kettle from home. it does not belong on this floor.
mem.ye_kettle.done: it was cold. it was always cold. the cups went to the department.
mem.ye_chair.flash: your chair. there is no desk any more.
mem.ye_chair.done: it faces the washroom door. it always did.
mem.ye_slippers.flash: your slippers. you came to work in them.
mem.ye_slippers.done: the tiles are warm where you stood. reception is calling your name.
mem.ye_clock.flash: the clock. ten to six. the same ten to six.
mem.ye_clock.done: the lift is coming up. it is the same floor.
mem.sh_coat.flash: a hat. not from this house. smells of the station.
mem.sh_coat.done: no keys under it. the hatch was open. everyone went down — to sleep.
mem.of_ticket.flash: a train ticket, filed with the reports. one way.
mem.of_ticket.done: you never went. they are talking about it by the water cooler.
meta.m02.0: can you bring my slippers tomorrow
meta.m04: if the fever hasn't dropped by morning, call. the number is on the fridge.
meta.m05.1: fine. go to sleep. you have a fever too
meta.m09.0: sorry. i fell asleep. i'm coming
meta.m10: i still put out two cups.

koma.owner.lp01: child, six. kitchen. poured it himself.
koma.owner.lp10: elderly man. lives alone. no children.
koma.owner.other: someone who never came back for it.
koma.fact.head: known for certain
koma.fact.lp05: an alarm clock. wound. the glass is whole.
koma.fact.lp01: a kettle. limescale at the bottom. its own lid.
koma.fact.lp10: a remote. batteries in place. one button worn off.
koma.fact.rest: nothing else. that is not little.
koma.owner.lp02: a student. going home. changed his mind.
koma.owner.lp03: woman, thirty. in a hurry. said she would come back.
koma.owner.lp04: a family. summer. all still together.
koma.owner.lp06: a secretary. gave everyone the same answer.
koma.owner.lp07: a man. his first flat of his own.
koma.owner.lp08: an operator. night shift. liked things in order.
koma.owner.lp09: whoever wrote it was in a great hurry.
koma.owner.lp11: a man. waited for a train. took it off for a minute.
koma.owner.lp13: the manager. stayed to the last. left without goodbye.
koma.owner.lp14: a passenger. ran late. never went after that.
koma.fact.lp02: a ticket. punched. the date is rubbed off.
koma.fact.lp03: a hat. the band sewn on with a different thread. nothing inside.
koma.fact.lp04: a photograph. five people. the faces cannot be made out.
koma.fact.lp06: a telephone. the cord is twisted. no dial tone.
koma.fact.lp07: a key. the number is filed off. one of many.
koma.fact.lp08: a terminal. switched on. the cursor blinks.
koma.fact.lp09: a note. even handwriting. the same as on the tags.
koma.fact.lp11: a hat. worn. a ticket behind the band.
koma.fact.lp13: a chair. one wheel does not turn. the back is worn in.
koma.fact.lp14: a ticket. unused. there is a name on it.
koma.a2_e01.caretaker_01: you have been here a long time.
koma.a2_e03.visitor_02: i just need to pick it up.
koma.a2_e04.player_01: did i make all of this up?
koma.a3_e01.player_02: why are you not writing it down?
koma.a3_e01.caretaker_02: i do not want to get it wrong.
koma.a3_e02.rita_01: your desk has to be cleared too.
koma.a3_e02.rita_02: you have known for three months.
koma.a3_e03.staff_02: no. his things are with us, in a bag.
koma.a3_e03.staff_03: put him down without a name for now.
koma.a3_e04.caretaker_02: not all. they came from somewhere.
koma.a3_e04.player_03: but i did not live this.
koma.a4_e01.caretaker_02: but we know where everything is.
koma.a4_e02.caretaker_01: pick the one that suits you.
koma.a4_e02.caretaker_02: then it will have to stay blank.
koma.a4_e04.player_00: i do not have to take it.
koma.a5_e02.player_01: i was going to go away.
koma.a5_e02.player_03: i wanted to have a look.
